title: Find cheapest 16GB VPS India
goal: Find me the cheapest VPS for a 16GB ram in india

result.output_text:
We compared **16 GB RAM VPS offers with India hosting** from Host IT Smart, Matrix Host, Hostinger, Getwebup, and BigRock. Location or billing details that remained unconfirmed are flagged in the report.

**Cheapest found among the plans checked:** [Host IT Smart VPS – SM 3](https://www.hostitsmart.com/servers/vps-hosting).

- **Specs:** 4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, 200 GB SSD, 16 TB bandwidth; self-managed Linux.
- **Initial payment:** ₹17,520 before GST for 24 months, plus six bonus months. The configuration page confirmed “We've added 6 extra months to your 2-year VPS plan” and “18% GST will be applicable”.
- **Calculated total:** ₹20,673.60 including GST, equivalent to **₹689.12/month over the initial 30 months**. This requires upfront payment, not monthly billing.
- **Advertised renewal:** ₹1,630/month before GST.
- **Location:** The provider states an Indian data center; the exact city was not established.

For monthly billing, [Matrix Host](https://matrixhost.in/vps/16gb-ram) was the lowest candidate found at **₹999/month before taxes** in Noida. Its higher renewal price remains unconfirmed because the order page required login.

The [full comparison and source/access notes](outputs/india-16gb-vps.md) are saved. Access issues were resolved using the correct Getwebup URL and browser access for BigRock; the report documents those retries. No account was created, payment entered, or order submitted.
